title: Buy the Pullback
briefing: Nimbus Cloud is in a steady uptrend. Instead of chasing green days, wait for a pullback toward the rising average, then join the trend with a stop.
objective: Trend following: enter on pullbacks, trail the exit, let the trend do the work.
debrief: Nimbus Cloud kept making higher highs and higher lows. The share sale on day 7 and the price-target cut on day 20 were pullbacks toward the rising 20-day average, the low-risk places to join. The warning about slower sign-ups on day 29 finally broke the trend, and a trailing exit got out with most of the gain. A disciplined player bought a pullback, protected it with a stop and let the trend, not the news feed, decide the exit.
